meta.name: image-outpainting
meta.description: Image outpainting on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — extend a still beyond its original canvas, fill in what the camera didn't capture, change aspect ratio (square → 16:9, portrait → landscape) while preserving the original content. Routes across Nano Banana 2 Edit (default, spatial-language driven), GPT Image 2 Edit (multi-ref with reference-style matching), FLUX Kontext Pro (single-shot maximum-preservation), and the brand edit endpoints (Seedream / Dreamina / Qwen / FLUX 2). Picks the right route based on whether the outpaint is prose-driven, reference-driven, or brand-locked. Triggers on "outpaint", "outpainting", "extend image canvas", "expand the image", "fill in around the photo", "uncrop", "change aspect ratio", "extend frame", "wide-screen from square", or any explicit ask to add canvas around an existing still.

copy.tagline: 扩展图片画布，补全缺失内容，改变画面比例
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把图片扩展成不同比例或补全画面外内容
copy.tagline_en: Extend image canvas, fill in missing content, change aspect ratio
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to extend images beyond their original canvas or change aspect ratio

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 RunComfy CLI 扩展图片画布，比如把正方形变宽屏、露出被裁掉的部分，同时保留原图内容。它会根据你的描述自动选择最合适的模型。
howto.when: 当你提到“outpaint”、“扩展画布”、“改变宽高比”等关键词，或要求给现有图片添加画布时触发。

say.text: 把这张正方形图片扩展成16:9宽屏，左右补充匹配的环境。
向下扩展这张头像，露出人物的上半身和手臂。
say.note: Claude 会保持原图内容不变，仅向下添加画布。

say.text: 用这张参考图风格，把照片扩展成21:9横幅。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can extend an image's canvas via the RunComfy CLI — e.g., change a square to widescreen, uncrop a portrait, while preserving the original content. It automatically picks the best model based on your description.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "outpaint", "extend canvas", "change aspect ratio", or explicitly ask to add canvas around an existing image.

say_en.text: Extend this square image to 16:9 widescreen, adding matching environment on both sides.
say_en.note: Claude will use the Nano Banana 2 Edit model.

say_en.text: Uncrop this portrait downward to reveal the subject's upper body and arms.
say_en.note: Claude preserves the original content and only adds canvas below.

say_en.text: Extend this photo to 21:9 banner using this reference image for style.
say_en.note: Claude will use GPT Image 2 Edit to match the reference style.
